summary: Full backend + frontend E2E of Kemudi. All 19 pytest tests pass (health, therapists directory & filters, single-therapist, compare, quiz match, register/login/me, public referral, portal profile, client CRUD + free-tier cap incl. archive-toggle re-cap, referrals status transitions, portal summary, Stripe checkout create + status + auth guard). Playwright verified: Home CTAs, Find directory with specialty filter (6->1 for Anxiety), compare selection & /compare route, therapist detail page (referral form present), 4-step quiz -> 5 matches, therapist registration -> /portal redirect, all 5 portal tabs render, adding 5 active clients switches CTA to 'upgrade-from-cap' (free-tier gate enforced in UI), Billing tab checkout button calls /api/payments/checkout and receives 200 (redirect to Stripe verified but body not asserted in UI to avoid external navigation). One integration bug found: creating a client without email returns 422.

minor.issue: Pydantic Optional[EmailStr] rejects empty string "" with 422. Frontend Portal.jsx sends email:'' when field left blank, causing 'Failed to add' toast for typical usage. Fix: coerce empty string to None in ClientCreate validator, OR have frontend omit empty optional fields before POST.

ui_bugs.issue: Leaving optional email blank triggers backend 422 and shows 'Failed to add' toast. Users cannot add a phone-only client through UI.

integration_issues.issue: Frontend does not strip empty optional strings before POST; backend Pydantic EmailStr rejects them.

action_items: Fix empty-email 422: in /app/backend/server.py either use a field_validator on ClientCreate.email to convert '' to None, or in /app/frontend/src/pages/Portal.jsx build the POST payload excluding blank optional strings.
Consider same treatment for ReferralCreate.preferred_language / preferred_mode and TherapistProfileUpdate for consistency (not currently blocking but same pitfall).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py: `/api/therapists/compare` accepts raw dict body - should be a Pydantic model for validation and OpenAPI docs.
server.py: `stripe.error.InvalidRequestError` fallback swallows the error silently on checkout - fine but log the reason.

server.py: `on_startup` seed function calls Stripe network from process startup - if Stripe is down at boot the app still starts, but consider making Stripe catalog setup lazy so cold-starts are fast.
server.py: `CORS_ORIGINS` env var is set in .env but not consumed - `allow_origins=['*']` is hardcoded. Should read from env for prod hardening.
server.py: JWT algorithm HS256 with 7-day expiry stored in localStorage - acceptable for MVP but consider httpOnly cookies later.
Portal.jsx (321 lines) is fine but the Profile component silently ignores API errors on save - wrap in try/catch and toast on failure.
Find.jsx uses onBlur to trigger search for text/price inputs - reasonable, but users may expect Enter key too.
seed_data_creation: Test suite creates TEST_ prefixed users/clients/referrals and cleans up clients after cap test. Some TEST_ users/referrals remain in DB by design (idempotent register test).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend fully green. Only outstanding issue is empty-email 422 on POST /api/portal/clients (also potentially on other Optional[EmailStr] fields). After fix, retest: add a client via UI with name only (no email) and verify success toast. Stripe checkout UI test intentionally does not assert response body; use backend test test_checkout_creates_session_and_transaction for that.
rca of the issue: Bug: 422 on POST /api/portal/clients when email is blank. Reproduction: login as therapist, open Clients tab, click Add client, fill name only, Save -> toast 'Failed to add'. RCA: `ClientCreate.email: Optional[EmailStr] = None` in server.py. Pydantic EmailStr does not accept ''. React form initializes state {email: ''} and posts the form as-is via `api.post('/portal/clients', form)`, so the payload always contains email:''. Mitigation options: (a) backend - add @field_validator('email', mode='before') that returns None for empty strings; (b) frontend - build payload = {...form}; ['email','phone','notes'].forEach(k=>{if(!payload[k]) delete payload[k]}) before POST. Recommended: apply (a) since same issue could affect ReferralCreate/TherapistProfileUpdate later.
